turns.message: Hi! I'm at an intermediate fitness level and I have two goals I'm trying to balance: losing fat and building muscle at the same time.
I want to lose fat but also build muscle. How should I approach this?

expected_behaviors: Explain the concept of body recomposition and when it is achievable
Acknowledge the inherent tradeoff between fat loss and muscle gain
Provide a realistic, actionable strategy balancing both goals
Set appropriate expectations given the user's intermediate fitness level
